<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="25" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">9:42</text>
    <line x1="314" y1="20" x2="314" y2="25" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="319" y1="17" x2="319" y2="25" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="324" y1="14" x2="324" y2="25" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="338" cy="20" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="341" y1="23" x2="345" y2="27" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="353" y="14" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="356" y="17" width="15" height="6" rx="1" fill="#18191F"/>
    <rect x="376" y="18" width="3" height="4" rx="1" fill="#18191F"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <text x="31" y="76" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Welcome back</text>
    <text x="31" y="108" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">Sign in to continue to your account.</text>
    <circle cx="356" cy="77" r="18" fill="#F4F5F7" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="350" y1="71" x2="362" y2="83" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="362" y1="71" x2="350" y2="83" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Form -->
  <g>
    <text x="31" y="161" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Email address</text>
    <rect x="31" y="171" width="327" height="56" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="51" y="206" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#18191F">alex.morgan@example.com</text>

    <text x="31" y="265" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Password</text>
    <rect x="31" y="275" width="327" height="56" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="51" y="310" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="21" font-weight="500" fill="#18191F">••••••••••••</text>
    <circle cx="332" cy="303" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#474A57" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="326" y1="310" x2="338" y2="296" stroke="#474A57" stroke-width="2"/>

    <rect x="31" y="357" width="20" height="20" rx="4" fill="#00C6AE" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="36,367 40,371 47,363" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="61" y="373" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#18191F">Remember me</text>
    <text x="256" y="373" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#1947E5">Forgot password?</text>

    <rect x="33" y="412" width="327" height="60" rx="16" fill="#18191F"/>
    <g>
      <rect x="31" y="410" width="327" height="60" rx="16" fill="#FFBD12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="194.5" y="447" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Sign in</text>
    </g>

    <line x1="31" y1="515" x2="151" y2="515" stroke="#EEEFF4" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="239" y1="515" x2="358" y2="515" stroke="#EEEFF4" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="520" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#969BAB">New to Contra?</text>

    <g>
      <rect x="31" y="548" width="327" height="56" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="194.5" y="583" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Create new account</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Helpful footer note -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="47" cy="658" r="14" fill="#E9E7FC" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="47" y="663" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="800" fill="#1947E5">i</text>
    <text x="71" y="656" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Your information is secure</text>
    <text x="71" y="675" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">We never share your personal details.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="757" width="390" height="87" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="757" x2="390" y2="757" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>

    <!-- Home -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="38,785 49,776 60,785" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="42" y="784" width="14" height="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="49" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Home</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Discover -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="127" cy="786" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="127" y1="780" x2="127" y2="792" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="121" y1="786" x2="133" y2="786" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="127" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#969BAB">Discover</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Messages -->
    <g>
      <rect x="196" y="777" width="22" height="16" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="201,793 205,793 201,798" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="203" cy="785" r="1.5" fill="#969BAB"/>
      <circle cx="208" cy="785" r="1.5" fill="#969BAB"/>
      <circle cx="213" cy="785" r="1.5" fill="#969BAB"/>
      <text x="207" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#969BAB">Messages</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Profile -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="294" cy="781" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="294" cy="795" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#969BAB" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="294" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#969BAB">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
